zh.name: 可复制笔记清单
zh.summary: 用索引列出一组有明确用途的笔记，再逐页展示可照抄的真实内容结构。
zh.useWhen: 每页是完整可用的笔记样本；区别于手机功能教程和只推荐笔记软件。
zh.instructions: 各笔记用途、真实样例、可编辑字段
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Copyable Notes Reference
en.summary: Create an Instagram reference carousel using the copyable notes reference structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the copyable notes reference format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 封面淡粉底、黑色超粗无衬线大标题90–114px，占左上55%，底部白色小胶囊列笔记索引
内页奶油/淡黄底，左上编号与笔记名60–78px，左侧约35%说明为什么与何时用，右侧约52%放手机笔记框，笔记正文28–34px
